notes.recognition: Long conductive legs and split lightning antennae clearly read as a storm walker.
notes.agency: Its planted stance suggests ground, lure, or wait through a storm event.
notes.specificity: The creature turns Xenovoya's stormneedle geology into living anatomy.
notes.restraint: A narrow vertical silhouette and two restrained glow channels avoid noise.

notes.reusability: Tall thin legs need minimum-size rules but remain viable with padding.
notes.accessibility: Extreme proportions identify the creature without depending on hue.
